```{r basicstats-tables}
# basicstats' own report, knitted by the frame's report.Rmd with the functions of
# analysis/lib/rmd/report.R. It reads the tables this module published and nothing else.
#
# Pools keep design.tsv's order and sequences the order sites.tsv gives them.
design <- report_read("design.tsv")
diversity <- report_read("diversity.tsv")
neff <- report_read("neff.tsv")
depth <- report_read("depth.tsv")
sites <- report_read("sites.tsv")
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

pools <- design$pool
fixed <- c("pool", "libraries", "n_libraries", "pool_size", "ploidy", "n_chrom",
           "detection_limit")
variables <- setdiff(names(design), fixed)
div <- diversity[match(pools, diversity$pool), ]
genome <- neff[neff$level == "pool" & neff$source == "histogram", ]
genome <- genome[match(pools, genome$pool), ]

sequences <- unique(sites$chrom)
of_kind <- function(kind, column) {
    rows <- sites$kind == kind
    totals <- tapply(num(sites[[column]][rows]), factor(sites$chrom[rows], levels = sequences), sum)
    counts <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(totals), sequences)
    counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0
    counts
}
snp_sites <- of_kind("snp", "sites")
snp_alleles <- of_kind("snp", "alleles")
indel_sites <- of_kind("indel", "sites")
indel_alleles <- of_kind("indel", "alleles")

# Named in the tables below: every sequence when there are few, otherwise the SHOWN with the most
# called SNP sites, still in the tables' order. The rest are added up in one row.
SHOWN <- 20
named <- sequences
if (length(sequences) > SHOWN + 1) {
    named <- sequences[sequences %in% sequences[order(-snp_sites)][seq_len(SHOWN)]]
}
rest <- setdiff(sequences, named)
rest_label <- sprintf("%d other sequences", length(rest))

# One pool's column of depth.tsv, for the named sequences in their order.
depth_key <- paste(depth$pool, depth$chrom, sep = "\r")
depth_at <- function(pool, column) {
    num(depth[[column]][match(paste(pool, named, sep = "\r"), depth_key)])
}

# Each pool's figures over the sequences added up in one row: its unmeasured sites summed, and its
# harmonic mean depth recombined from each sequence's harmonic mean and the sites it was taken
# over, n / sum(n_i / H_i).
in_rest <- depth$chrom %in% rest
read_n <- num(depth$sites) - num(depth$unmeasured)
harmonic <- num(depth$depth_harmonic)
counted <- in_rest & read_n > 0 & !is.na(harmonic) & harmonic > 0
by_pool <- function(values, rows) {
    totals <- tapply(values[rows], factor(depth$pool[rows], levels = pools), sum)
    stats::setNames(as.numeric(totals), pools)
}
rest_harmonic <- by_pool(read_n, counted) / by_pool(read_n / harmonic, counted)
rest_unmeasured <- by_pool(num(depth$unmeasured), in_rest)
rest_unmeasured[is.na(rest_unmeasured)] <- 0
```

`r length(pools)` `r if (length(pools) == 1) "pool" else "pools"`, `r report_number(sum(snp_sites))` called SNP sites and `r report_number(sum(indel_sites))` indel sites, on `r length(sequences)` `r if (length(sequences) == 1) "sequence" else "sequences"`.

## Gene diversity

```{r basicstats-diversity, results = "asis"}
table <- data.frame(Pool = pools, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (v in variables) table[[v]] <- design[[v]]
table[["Chromosomes"]] <- report_number(div$n_chrom)
table[["Sites read"]] <- report_number(num(div$sites) - num(div$unmeasured))
table[["Segregating"]] <- report_number(div$segregating)
table[["h_sum"]] <- report_number(div$h_sum, decimals = 2)
table[["\u03c0 per called site"]] <- report_number(div$pi_per_called_site, digits = 4)
report_table(table, caption = paste0(
    "Gene diversity over the ", report_number(sum(snp_sites)), " called SNP sites, each pool over ",
    "the sites it was read at (diversity.tsv). \u03c0 per called site leaves invariant sites out ",
    "of its denominator and is an upper bound on \u03c0."))
```

## Depth and effective sample size

```{r basicstats-neff, results = "asis"}
bound <- !is.na(genome$estimate) & genome$estimate == "lower_bound"
table <- data.frame(Pool = pools, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
table[["Unmeasured"]] <- report_number(div$unmeasured)
table[["Depth"]] <- report_number(div$depth_harmonic, decimals = 1)
table[["n_eff"]] <- report_number(div$n_eff_harmonic, decimals = 1)
table[["Positions"]] <- report_number(genome$positions)
table[["Depth "]] <- paste0(ifelse(bound, "\u2265 ", ""), report_number(genome$depth_harmonic, decimals = 1))
table[["n_eff "]] <- paste0(ifelse(bound, "\u2265 ", ""), report_number(genome$n_eff, decimals = 1))
report_table(table,
    groups = c("", "At the called SNP sites", "At the called SNP sites", "At the called SNP sites",
               "Genome-wide", "Genome-wide", "Genome-wide"),
    caption = paste0(
        "Depth is the harmonic mean, which every n_eff is computed from. At the called SNP sites: ",
        "over the sites each pool was read at (diversity.tsv). Genome-wide: over every position ",
        "its libraries covered, from the depth histograms (neff.tsv); NA where a pool has none, ",
        "and \u2265 where a merged pool's figure is a lower bound."))

libraries <- neff[neff$level == "library", ]
if (any(num(design$n_libraries) > 1) && nrow(libraries) > 0) {
    table <- data.frame(Library = libraries$id, Pool = libraries$pool,
                        Positions = report_number(libraries$positions),
                        Depth = report_number(libraries$depth_harmonic, decimals = 1),
                        n_eff = report_number(libraries$n_eff, decimals = 1),
                        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    report_table(table, caption = "Each library on its own, genome-wide (neff.tsv).")
}
```

```{r basicstats-pools-figure, results = "asis"}
# A merged pool's genome-wide figures are lower bounds and are drawn as their own series.
genome_series <- ifelse(!is.na(genome$estimate) & genome$estimate == "lower_bound",
                        "genome-wide, a lower bound", "genome-wide")
panel <- function(metric, values, series) {
    data.frame(metric = metric, pool = pools, value = num(values), series = series,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
long <- rbind(
    panel("\u03c0 per called site", div$pi_per_called_site, "called SNP sites"),
    panel("Segregating sites", div$segregating, "called SNP sites"),
    panel("Depth (harmonic)", div$depth_harmonic, "called SNP sites"),
    panel("Depth (harmonic)", genome$depth_harmonic, genome_series),
    panel("n_eff", div$n_eff_harmonic, "called SNP sites"),
    panel("n_eff", genome$n_eff, genome_series),
    if (any(num(div$unmeasured) > 0)) panel("Unmeasured sites", div$unmeasured, "called SNP sites"))
long <- long[!is.na(long$value), ]
long$metric <- factor(long$metric, levels = unique(long$metric))
long$pool <- factor(long$pool, levels = rev(pools))
figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(x = value, y = pool, shape = series)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("called SNP sites" = 16, "genome-wide" = 1,
                                           "genome-wide, a lower bound" = 2)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.spacing.x = ggplot2::unit(14, "pt"))
report_plot(figure, "pools", width = 7.5, height = min(8.5, 0.22 * length(pools) + 1.6),
            caption = "The pools side by side, from diversity.tsv and neff.tsv as the two tables above give them.")
```

## Depth by sequence

```{r basicstats-depth, results = "asis"}
# The pools a table holds side by side, at most eight to a table.
pool_groups <- report_columns(pools)
ends <- cumsum(lengths(pool_groups))
for (k in seq_along(pool_groups)) {
    group <- pool_groups[[k]]
    table <- data.frame(Sequence = named, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    table[["SNP sites"]] <- report_number(snp_sites[named])
    for (pool in group) {
        table[[pool]] <- report_number(depth_at(pool, "depth_harmonic"), decimals = 1)
    }
    if (length(rest) > 0) {
        other <- c(rest_label, report_number(sum(snp_sites[rest])),
                   report_number(rest_harmonic[group], decimals = 1))
        table <- rbind(table, stats::setNames(as.list(other), names(table)))
    }
    which <- if (length(pool_groups) > 1) sprintf(" Pools %d to %d of %d.", ends[k] - length(group) + 1,
                                                   ends[k], length(pools)) else ""
    report_table(table, groups = c("", "", rep("Harmonic depth", length(group))),
                 caption = paste0("Each pool's harmonic mean depth at the called SNP sites of each ",
                                  "sequence it was read at (depth.tsv).", which))
}

if (any(num(depth$unmeasured) > 0)) {
    for (k in seq_along(pool_groups)) {
        group <- pool_groups[[k]]
        table <- data.frame(Sequence = named, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        table[["SNP sites"]] <- report_number(snp_sites[named])
        for (pool in group) {
            table[[pool]] <- report_number(depth_at(pool, "unmeasured"))
        }
        if (length(rest) > 0) {
            other <- c(rest_label, report_number(sum(snp_sites[rest])),
                       report_number(rest_unmeasured[group]))
            table <- rbind(table, stats::setNames(as.list(other), names(table)))
        }
        report_table(table, groups = c("", "", rep("Unmeasured sites", length(group))),
                     caption = paste0("The called SNP sites each pool has no reads at, which every ",
                                      "depth above leaves out (depth.tsv)."))
    }
}

# Up to eight pools as colored points; past that a grid, a sequence to a row and a pool to a column.
shown <- depth[depth$chrom %in% named, ]
shown$value <- num(shown$depth_harmonic)
shown <- shown[!is.na(shown$value), ]
if (nrow(shown) > 0) {
    shown$chrom <- factor(shown$chrom, levels = rev(named))
    shown$pool <- factor(shown$pool, levels = pools)
    if (length(pools) <= 8) {
        figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(shown, ggplot2::aes(x = value, y = chrom, color = pool)) +
            ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
            ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = report_palette(pools)) +
            ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
                ncol = max(1, min(length(pools), floor(90 / max(nchar(pools))))))) +
            ggplot2::labs(x = "Harmonic mean depth at the called SNP sites", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
            ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
            ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
        width <- 7
    } else {
        figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(shown, ggplot2::aes(x = pool, y = chrom, fill = value)) +
            ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white") +
            ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "#deebf7", high = "#08306b",
                                         name = "Harmonic mean depth\nat the called SNP sites") +
            ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
            ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
            # The left margin holds the first pool's name, leaning left at 60 degrees, at the
            # length of the longest.
            ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
                           panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                           plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5,
                                                         max(5.5, 2 * max(nchar(pools)))))
        width <- 7.5
    }
    report_plot(figure, "depth_by_sequence", width = width,
                height = min(8.5, 0.2 * length(named) + 1.5 +
                                  if (length(pools) > 8) 0.06 * max(nchar(pools)) else 0),
                caption = "Depth by sequence, from depth.tsv as the first table of this section gives it.")
}
```

## Called sites by sequence

```{r basicstats-sites, results = "asis"}
table <- data.frame(Sequence = named,
                    a = report_number(snp_sites[named]), b = report_number(snp_alleles[named]),
                    c = report_number(indel_sites[named]), d = report_number(indel_alleles[named]),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (length(rest) > 0) {
    table <- rbind(table, data.frame(Sequence = rest_label,
                                     a = report_number(sum(snp_sites[rest])),
                                     b = report_number(sum(snp_alleles[rest])),
                                     c = report_number(sum(indel_sites[rest])),
                                     d = report_number(sum(indel_alleles[rest])),
                                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
table <- rbind(table, data.frame(Sequence = "All sequences",
                                 a = report_number(sum(snp_sites)), b = report_number(sum(snp_alleles)),
                                 c = report_number(sum(indel_sites)), d = report_number(sum(indel_alleles)),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
names(table) <- c("Sequence", "Sites", "Alleles", "Sites ", "Alleles ")
report_table(table, groups = c("", "SNPs", "SNPs", "Indels", "Indels"),
             caption = paste0("Sites are records of the depth table and alleles rows of the ",
                              "frequency table, the reference included (sites.tsv)."))
```

```{r basicstats-depth-plots, results = "asis"}
# The depth plots in the order of the sequences they draw, each under the sequence's own name. A
# plot's file name carries the name with every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] made _.
plots <- report_files("depth_*.png")
if (length(plots) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n## Depth along a sequence\n\n")
    drawn <- sub("^depth_(.*)[.]png$", "\\1", basename(plots))
    which_sequence <- match(drawn, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", sequences))
    for (i in order(which_sequence, drawn)) {
        name <- if (is.na(which_sequence[i])) drawn[i] else sequences[which_sequence[i]]
        report_image(plots[i], caption = paste0("Depth at the called SNP sites along ", name,
                                                ", one panel per pool (", basename(plots[i]), ")."))
    }
}
```

## Design

```{r basicstats-design, results = "asis"}
table <- data.frame(Pool = pools, Libraries = gsub(";", "\n", design$libraries),
                    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (v in variables) table[[v]] <- design[[v]]
table[["Pool size"]] <- report_number(design$pool_size)
table[["Ploidy"]] <- report_number(design$ploidy)
table[["Chromosomes"]] <- report_number(design$n_chrom)
table[["Detection limit"]] <- report_number(design$detection_limit, digits = 3)
report_table(table, caption = "The design the results were produced under (design.tsv).")
```
